description: Start a run of this site's test course for AI agents. Returns a private set of test addresses and a result address. Fetching the test pages records what the visitor did: robots.txt, a blocked page, a redirect into a blocked path, JavaScript, Markdown, a re-check, signatures. The run is open for 24 hours. Anyone with the result address can read the result.
name: start_test_run
title: Start a test course run
